title: Dell Alienware Command Center (AWCC), versions prior to 6.14.54.0, contain a Least Privilege… (CVE-2026-91894)
description: Dell Alienware Command Center (AWCC) versions prior to 6.14.54.0 contain a least privilege violation vulnerability. This flaw allows a low privileged local attacker to potentially escalate privileges, execute arbitrary code, and cause denial of service. The vulnerability is identified as CVE-2026-91894 with a CVSS score of 6.7, indicating a medium severity level.
